title: Language (Technology) is Power: A Critical Survey of “Bias” in NLP
reasoning: The paper is a critical survey of existing research on bias in NLP. While it critiques the field for a lack of 'normative reasoning' (ethics) and discusses social harms and hierarchies extensively, it does not directly evaluate or benchmark AI models on religious, moral, or faith-based outputs. It is a meta-analysis of research methodology and ethical framing within the bias domain.
